name: Wataru Endo

career_stints.note: J2/J1 League, six seasons. J2 League Monthly MVP 2014 as Shonan won promotion to J1.
Won the J.League YBC Levain Cup, the 2017 AFC Champions League, and the Suruga Bank Championship.
Belgian First Division A, league-only total. Single season before an initial loan to Stuttgart.
Bundesliga league-only total across an initial loan (from 2019) plus a permanent spell through 2023. Became Japan's national team captain during this period and played at the 2022 World Cup.

All competitions combined across his first two Liverpool seasons since an August 2023 move. Premier League-only split: 57 apps, 1 goal, 1 assist. Backup defensive midfielder role, playing time reduced further in 2024/25.

Premier League only, 170 minutes. Squad role diminished sharply under Slot; sidelined the final three months of the season with a foot injury, describing himself as in a 'difficult moment' out of starting contention. One source separately cited 12 total appearances / 455 minutes across all competitions for the season -- kept the more specific 8-app / 170-minute Premier League figure rather than merge inconsistent totals.

notes: basis reasoning: his single most recent season (2025/26, 170 PL minutes) is too thin to be representative -- comparable to the Isak precedent -- so playstyle_metrics instead draws on the combined 2023/24-2024/25 Liverpool sample (87 apps, well above the ~900-minute/10-start threshold), classified as liverpool_recent_minutes since it is still Liverpool data, just a two-season aggregate rather than a single clean season. Confidence kept low (0.45) given the steep recent decline in his role.

No injury currently listed in data/squad/liverpool_2026_27.json for 2026/27. Reporting from thisisanfield.com (May 2026) describes him as 'close to making a full return' from the 2025/26 foot injury heading into the US pre-season tour -- treated as recovering/fit rather than currently injured, consistent with the squad file.

No advanced per-90 metrics (shots, xG, pass accuracy, progressive passes, touches, duels won%) were verifiable for the combined 2023/24-2024/25 Liverpool sample from an accessible source -- left null rather than guessed. Some raw 2025/26 figures were found (50.82 passes/game, 83.33% pass completion, 1.06 fouls/90) but were not used as they describe the too-thin 2025/26 sample, not the source season chosen above.
